name: gymflow

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"

description: Multi-tenant gym management SaaS (Next.js + Express + PostgreSQL)
